interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.29.0: three opt-in, read-only measurements. Korean memory evaluation --answer-rates reports response rate, silent error rate among answered cases with one-sided upper bounds, and accuracy on answerable and should-abstain cases, so a mixed accuracy no longer hides wrong answers. Recall evaluation --success-bounds adds one-sided lower bounds to all-expected-found headline rates. Lesson proposals gain preserve-check, which compares a stored original and candidate by occurrence counts of numbers, dates, names and declared phrases. Results are review material; nothing gates, applies or approves. Without the new flags and subcommand, outputs and exit codes are unchanged. Existing memory reliability tools, 15 slash commands, Jarvis API authentication and v0.26.0 upgrade requirements remain. No default hook/search change, model/network call, new runtime dependency or automatic vault migration.
defaultPrompt: Use agentic-vault to restore this vault's session context.
